Natalie (AE): Quick heads up — Constellation confirmed three-day joint POC starting Tue 10am PT. They want live traffic shaping + shared telemetry, and a short pricing estimate for a Dedicated pool vs hosted fallback.
Alex (Partner Eng): Awesome. Who's owning infra handoff?
Natalie (AE): @Praveen can you take infra? I'll handle commercial and Constellation PM.
Praveen (Infra): I can. Need to know expected QPS and max seq len. Are they planning embedding-heavy calls or chat LLM traffic?
Sam (Solutions): Mostly chat with occasional long context (4–6k tokens) and an embeddings pipeline for search prefixing. Rough estimate: 200 rps peak, 20 concurrent sessions.
Praveen (Infra): Got it. For that footprint recommend Dedicated G4dn-style pool + autoscale with burst to hosted. I'll sketch capacity numbers.
Hana (Security): Constellation asked about data residency, KMS controls, and whether we support customer-managed keys for Private. Also need our answers for their security questionnaire (SOC2, encryption-in-transit, key rotation cadence).
Alex (Partner Eng): For the runbook, we should include: VPC peering steps, tenant entitlements, per-route routing policy (hosted fallback), and telemetry export (Prometheus + event export). I'll draft.
Natalie (AE): Constellation legal also wants a path for IP handling in a shared pilot. They prefer not to ingest PII. We'll add a note in the contract: "pilot data is synthetically masked or anonymized".
partners-bot: Tenant provisioning request (constellation-prod-sandbox) submitted by Natalie. Status: queued.
Praveen (Infra): Provisioned sandbox tenant: id const-sbx-44, VPC peering pending. Sample peering config for their infra team:
```
aws ec2 create-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-id vpc-1234abcd --peer-vpc-id vpc-5678efgh --peer-owner-id 999999999999
route table add: 10.10.0.0/16 -> pcx-0a1b2c3d
```
Alex (Partner Eng): For entitlements, they'll need 2 tokens: one for telemetry ingest (ingest-only role) and one for control-plane ops. We'll hand over a short-lived API key for the pilot.
Sam (Solutions): Pricing question from Constellation: "If we run 200rps chat with 4–6k context, what's ballpark monthly cost in Dedicated vs hosted?" Anyone have a quick calc?
Praveen (Infra): Ballpark: Dedicated commit to cover baseline (2 x A100-equivalent) ~$60k/mo + delta for egress and burst. Hosted estimate (pay-as-you-go) probably 40–60% higher at our current per-token rates for that seq length. I'll prepare a more detailed spreadsheet.
Hana (Security): I'll attach redacted answers for the security questionnaire. Key points: SOC2 Type II in scope, TLS 1.2+, customer-managed KMS supported in Private, HSM via partner in Private on request. Also need to confirm retention window for telemetry (default 90d; can extend).
Natalie (AE): Action items: Alex — draft the interop playbook and share runbook link. Praveen — capacity spreadsheet + peering steps. Hana — security questionnaire answers and doc. Sam — pricing calc & candidate rollout policy (canary -> full). I'll sync with Constellation PM tomorrow at 9am PT.
Alex (Partner Eng): Sharing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/constellation-poc (draft). Please add comments.
partners-bot: Tenant const-sbx-44: VPC peering created by Praveen at 1745124800.
Praveen (Infra): FYI: added IP allowlist for their CIDR and an ingress rule for telemetry port 9090.
Sam (Solutions): I'll put the pricing calc into the shared sheet and ping the thread when done.
Natalie (AE): Thanks all — super helpful. :thumbsup:
Alex (Partner Eng): On security questionnaire, Constellation asked whether we support air-gapped deployment for sensitive customers. Short answer: yes via Private deployment package — requires lead time for on-prem packaging.
Hana (Security): Noted. Also asked about audit logs export cadence — we support daily exports to their S3 or push to a SIEM via webhook.
Natalie (AE): Great. If nothing else, we'll reconvene after Praveen and Sam post the docs. Meeting invite sent for Tue 10am PT.
Praveen (Infra): I'll post the capacity spreadsheet link by EOD.
Sam (Solutions): Pricing sheet shared: https://redwood.internal/sheets/constellation-pricing (commented).
Natalie (AE): Closing note: keep thread updates short — any blockers flag with :rotating_light:.
